name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a conditional rule, so the hard Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) is the right template and propositions. Each ring lasts until a toggle, and siren_ringing is false on the toggle step, so the toggle that silences the siren discharges every obligation owed during that ring. This matches requiring a toggle after each ring starts. No Existence is needed because the consequent of 'each time' is a rule, and the rule-only warning is valid.

texts: Each time the siren starts ringing, toggle the siren switch to turn it off.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
